text:
Mobian is hiring Senior / Staff Engineers (Remote, Global) — AI-First Systems + Rapid Prototyping

Mobian is a brand safety, contextual intelligence, and measurement company working with the world's largest advertisers and publishers.

https://themobian.ai/about https://www.linkedin.com/company/themobian/posts/?feedView=a...

We’re building AI-powered brand safety and suitability infrastructure — and we’re hiring engineers across two tracks: Core Systems Engineers to design, scale, and harden production-grade APIs, data pipelines, ML deployments, cloud infrastructure leveraging the latest AI tooling. AI Prototyping Engineers to move fast with LLMs, browser automation, and experimental workflows — and turn winning experiments into durable product features.

What we value: AI-first mindset — you instinctively reach for automation and models to solve problems Strong product ownership — you can run full-stack initiatives end-to-end 10+ years of engineering experience and deep systems thinking Bias toward experimentation, speed, and iteration

Please reach out to careers@themobian.com with your resume, linkedin profile and github handle.
